name: Third
notes:
With this batch we tried to cool things more slowly by using the oven. This was another manual batch, we didn't have the pot yet.

These oven steps are from the Kukai entry, which applies to all candles in this batch unless stated otherwise:

> Heated jar to 120F, left in oven (off) while it cooled. After 10 mins, still totally liquid, at 110F air temp. Left in at 4:00pm. At 4:51pm the oven 200F. 150F at 4:58pm. 125F at 5:31pm. 150F at 5:42pm.

name: Horoscope
notes:
This is a 12 candle series, where we decided upon scents that match each of the 12 star signs.

This is the first batch we threw with the pot we made. With the pot, we were able to make just two large lots of wax to send the whole batch.

For this batch we had to re-oven all of the candles due to severe cratering. We think it is due to a combination of the paraffin wax and the new pouring technique, in particular how the intermediate vessel might have cooled the wax differently.

name: Fifth
notes: This was the second batch we threw using the pot. We did this one in front of the projector (the previous one was in the living room). Vibes were a bit off.

name: High Fantasy
notes:
With Kelly, Fatema, Yimeng, and Daniel.

We had no thermometer, so we just waited a while with the pot on R (of WARM) and then after pouring, waited roughly 5-10 minutes for it to cool down before pouring into the vessel.

name: Christmas 2023
notes:
Session with Daniel and Yimeng to make candles for Joe, Aida, Steve, Jess, Jen, and Tom at Nobottle for Christmas 2023.

Each batch was roughly 50/50 paraffin and soy wax. Any details in the entry for each candle supersedes the info here.

Target
Scent pour: 165 F (74 C)
Final pour: 115 F (46 C)

All supplies from “Candle Makers Supplies”

We used 3 metal intermediate vessels (from a thrift store), so we did them 3 at a time.

Not 100% confident in the measurements in absolute terms. They're pretty correct relative to each other though. This is with the Salter scales. Using oz, not floz.

These candles cratered (worst to least bad): Santa's Garden, Blitzen's Stroll, and Intemperence. We melted and poured in more after the fact.
